text_description: Full runway look shown from head to mid-thigh: a structured, collarless tweed jacket in a predominantly white base with dense red, black, and mint-green woven flecks, cut boxy and slightly cropped to the high hip with squared shoulders, long straight sleeves, and visibly frayed/raw edging around the round neckline, front opening, hem, and cuffs. The jacket is worn open over a close-fitting black one-piece or matching black top-and-bike-short base, creating a sharply fitted contrast beneath the textured outer layer. At the waist, a narrow white belt with a polished gold double-C-style buckle cinches the black base, while the shorts extend to mid-thigh and have a pale/white trim band at the hem. The jacket front is decorated with multiple colorful floral or camellia-like appliqués/brooches arranged vertically along the opening and near the chest, adding pastel green, yellow, pink, and darker accents. A large black textured shoulder bag hangs from the model’s left shoulder, held by the left hand, with a gold-toned chain or hardware detail visible near the strap. Minimal visible jewelry includes rings on the right hand; the styling is polished and ladylike with a tailored couture-inspired tweed jacket balanced against sporty fitted cycling shorts.
